author: iqzearo
quote: Max 30 fps is giving me headaches. Jason has the personality of a wash cloth. The humor is non existent. The story is lame at best. None of the characters are interesting. Much of what made the previous GTAs amazing is lacking from this game.

author: iqzearo
quote: An absolutely amazing game. Everything from the story, art, music, characters, and game play are just so good. Can't recommend this game enough.

author: iqzearo
quote: While the game had a horrible launch, they've made up for it with a really good game. So much fun to just explore and see what you'll run into when you login.

author: iqzearo
quote: An amazingly fun game, the story while good isn't why most people will play the game. The game play is ridiculously fluid and crisp. I'm having so much fun just playing the game, its refreshing.
game_title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon

author: iqzearo
quote: An amazing game, tons of content and so many different ways to play the game; overall just an amazing game. It only lost a point because the story was slightly forgettable.

author: iqzearo
quote:
2 out of 10,

The two points are because the story was enjoyable to play through 1 time. The other 8 points are lost because the game released as an unfinished project, its a downgrade over Diablo 3, a game that wasn't that great in its own right, and it's looking like we'll have to wait for season 2/3/4 for the game to be in a completed state.
